latest.title: Install updates yourself, from this screen
changes: When a new version is ready it appears at the top of this list, with what changed and a button to download it. No one needs to connect to this computer any more.
Before anything is installed, the system saves a complete copy of your data and shows you where it put it. INSTALL stays locked until that backup has been made.
Installing closes the system and opens it again by itself. It takes about two minutes - please don't switch the computer off while it works.
Your sales, clients, staff, settings and email login are not touched by an update.
